subtitle: A weekly review your AI runs one question at a time.
about: A note with five review questions, past weeks and a checklist of your top three for next week. Answer your AI one question at a time to save the review, then tick off your priorities.

ask.prompt: Set up the weekly review template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Review your week

slides.alt: The week's review, with the top three

slides.label: Midweek, check in
slides.you: Booked the dentist. What's left of my top three?
slides.ai: Ticked off Book the dentist. Left: finish the budget and run three times.
